title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN - Last night November 1st, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian MP made some remarks on exiting the NPT and moving toward Nuclear weapon in a TV talk show.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN - Last night November 1st, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian MP made some remarks on exiting the NPT and moving toward Nuclear weapon in a TV talk show."

"⭕️ This is the first time Iranian official speak such open about nuclear weapon!"

""
"================="

"SOT1, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian Parliament Member, (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:20): "Every threat, of any level or type, that our fighters or our country perceives must be met with an immediate, effective, and geographically unrestricted response.""

"SOT2, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian Parliament Member, (Farsi) (00:21 - 00:43): "[In the event of a new war,] geographic limitations will be removed. This means that wherever a conspiracy is formed or a movement takes shape against us, we can target it, in line with the Leader’s guidance on how to define targets within range.""

"SOT3, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian Parliament Member, (Farsi) (00:44 - 01:09): "The lifting of geographic limitations is clear in meaning, to our combatants, our nation, foreign parties, and our enemies. It means that if a war were to erupt, it would not be a regional war but an extra-regional one, because it would no longer be bound by geographic limits.""

"SOT4, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian Parliament Member, (Farsi) (01:10 - 01:26): "Europe has completely backed away from standing alongside the American terrorist army in confronting Iran, knowing that it will not achieve a better result than the Americans.""

"SOT5, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian Parliament Member, (Farsi) (01:27 - 02:17): "I think that if a decision must be made regarding the NPT and exiting from it, the time has come; however, we must take into account that exiting the NPT or the next step, which we will now explain a little regarding moving toward nuclear weapons, falls under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Leader [Ayatyollah Mojtaba Khamenei]. In fact, he is the ones who must, in a sense, decide, provide an opinion, or issue a statement, and actions should be taken based on that.""

"SOT6, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian Parliament Member, (Farsi) (02:18 - 02:51): "Americans should be careful; once, the use of a nuclear bomb brought the war to an end, but this time, if they commit such folly, the use of a nuclear bomb will be the initiator of war, and World War III will occur. If they accept the consequences then they can try it.""

"SOT7, Manouchehr Mottaki, Iranian Parliament Member, (Farsi) (02:52 - 03:36): "America cannot launch an attack on Iran; this has been clear for some time before the elections because all of Trump's thoughts and focus are set on the elections. They face a difficult elections, meaning this could lead to the erosion of the prestige, reputation, and track record of the Republicans, whom they present to the public as being more powerful than the Democrats in the country.
